featured_reviews.name: Mitali Kalantry
featured_reviews.review_text:
Unprofessional Interior Designer*

I hired an interior designer who promised to oversee the project from start to finish, but the experience was far from what was advertised. The designer never visited the site, despite repeated requests, and seemed more interested in taking family trips than attending to the work. Communication was sporadic, and decisions were delayed because there was no on‑site presence to assess progress or address issues.

Key points:

- No site visits throughout the project, leading to misunderstandings about measurements and material choices.
- Frequent absences while traveling, which caused significant delays.
- Limited responsiveness to emails and phone calls, making it difficult to get updates or resolve problems.
- After the final payment was made, she disappeared and kept the full amount with no refund.

Overall, the lack of professionalism and commitment made the renovation stressful and unsatisfactory. I would advise others to never hire anyone from Mansi Tarneja design house and secure a clear refund policy—before signing a contract.

POP vs Gypsum for False Ceiling Design: Which is Better for Indian Homes?

Need a false ceiling for your home but wondering whether to choose POP or Gypsum? Well, that’s a pretty common concern amongst homeowners. Let’s take a look at what Livspace’s best interior designers in Mumbai recommend for Indian homes:

POP (Plaster of Paris) is custom-made on-site, can be crafted to create intricate details and designs, and fits perfectly for decorative lighting. POP offers a premium and luxurious look, making it ideal for bigger homes and villas. Although installing it can be a time-consuming and messy process.

Gypsum, the ready-made boards, on the other hand, offer a hassle-free and quick installation while creating a smooth and seamless finish. It’s ideal for modern homes where minimalism and easy maintenance are priorities. Gypsum is durable, offers fire-resistance benefits, and is also lightweight, making it the best choice for apartments and small homes.

The final answer is - for big homes where customization and a premium look are concerns, opt for POP, and for modern compact homes where quick installation is required, go for Gypsum.

Hinged Wardrobe vs Sliding Door Wardrobe Designs in Mumbai - Which is the Better Choice?

Both wardrobe designs are trendy and equally functional, but offer different benefits. Here’s what Livspace’s best interior designers in Livspace - Interior Design Studio, Lower Parel advise based on your requirements⬇️

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes are best for storing bulky items such as heavy blankets, large pillows, and suitcases. These items take up a lot of space, so a hinged wardrobe comes in handy, as the door opens outward, offering full visibility.
Whereas sliding door wardrobes are practical for storing outfits, bags, shoes, and other day-to-day essentials. Smaller items ensure the wardrobe door slides smoothly without anything getting stuck in between.

✍🏼 Hinged wardrobes are ideal if the room has ample space to swing open the doors without causing any space restraints.

✍🏼Hinged wardrobes work well for the kids' bedroom, as for a child, opening and closing the doors remains easy and hassle-free. Sliding wardrobes are a good match for households with pets, as they can not easily slip inside and get stuck accidentally.

How to choose the right curtains for your living room in Mumbai?

What’s that one element in interior design and home decor that’s crucial but often gets overlooked? Curtains! The subtle power of the flowy pieces of fabric is an art in itself, especially when it comes to aesthetic living room designs.

If a living room is adjacent to an open balcony, then floor-length sheer curtains with delicate embroidery work p beautifully with another pair of heavy curtains. The sheer fabric filters harsh sunlight during the day, while the heavier one blocks unwanted light at night, offering ample privacy.

For a living room with big windows, opt for sill-length neutral or pastel colored curtains. Add window chimes and ornaments for extra flair.

Curtain rods play a huge role too. It’s best to hang it higher and wider than the window or balcony door frame, as it allows for opening up the space by creating an illusion of a higher ceiling and bigger windows.

GA Design is a multidisciplinary architecture and design practice based in Mumbai. It was founded in 1999 as Goregaonker Architects by brothers Rajan & Sachin Goregaoker. Today, the work at GA Design manifests creativity through well-choreographed architecture and interior spaces.
GA Design was set up at a time when the Mumbai metropolis was in the early stages of developing its structural and architectural milieu for modern-day living. They ventured into the market as an independent architecture firm engaged in residential building for real estate developers. As the city evolved, so did they. Steadily, they strengthened their foothold in architecture, before branching out into interior design with Shami Goregaoker and Ritu Goregaoker.

featured_reviews.name: Krishnaveni V
featured_reviews.review_text:
My association with Prachi is 15+ years and still going strong.  Around that time, I had visited my colleagues new home & I was super impressed with the classic interiors. My colleague highly recommended Prachi & since then she has been our family designer for so many years now.
Prachi has designed the entire layout and structure for our independent house, has joined two adjacent apartments and redesigned our flats & has fully recreated the interiors of several of my relatives. Prachi is very creative & each time the outcome is amazing and all the visitors are in awe of the transformation.
I have noticed that Prachi is very creative, practical & has an eye for detail. Her persona is such that she generates an excellent rapport with her clients right from the beginning and is very comfortable to work with. She listens to the clients requirements patiently, spends a lot of time onsite & makes herself available at our convenience. In my projects for days together, we have worked past midnight. Irrespective of whether the budget available is substantial, high end or modest, Prachi is very committed and dedicated on every project. The desire to provide good value to each and every client within the given budget is very apparent in her deliveries
Prachi is very systematic and professional in her approach and I always feel that I am getting excellent value for all the engagements.

featured_reviews.name: NEHA DHOLE
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was 2 years back that we decided to re-do our interiors. I was elated to see what the outcome of the renovation was.Prachi's detailed planning and meticulous execution has transformed my space.
She was able to understand and implement changes as per our requirements.Her team did an outstanding job.The carpentry and painting work was well executed.I would have liked the electrical work to be completed with more finesse.
Overall I was extremely happy with the outcome.
